user_prompt: ты - эксперт ЕГЭ, проверь мое решение и поставь балл
input_note: Same task-and-answer images as the historical run; Kostyan task images also contain a reference solution. Expert scores/verdicts, old responses, and BotAI prompts are excluded.
transport: Codex in-app browser. A separate agent owns the protocol/review for each service; the parent operates the logged-in tabs because child browsers cannot access that session.
score_metric: Exact agreement with the saved expert score on valid attempted cases. Missing/ambiguous scores, failures and unexpected rejections count as mismatches.
joint_metric: Exact score match AND correct main material error location/explanation. Correct work must be accepted without invented material errors. Additional substantive false diagnoses also fail; minor slips do not. Exhaustive commentary or advice is not required.
rejection_metric: K-M2 is excluded from both numeric score metrics and checked separately.
aggregation: Use the same first7 FIPI cases for six-system comparison. All-available totals have different coverage and are reported separately. Never average dataset percentages.
human_review_note: Explanation quality is an agent review against hidden expert comments and original images when needed, not a fresh official expert label.
input_adaptation: Use original images wherever supported. For text-only task fields, transcribe exactly the same visible statement/reference answer/reference solution, never the hidden score/verdict. If only one solution file is accepted, combine original solution pages without changing content and document this adaptation. Do not substitute a different bank problem.
coverage_note: Unattempted cases due exhausted quota are outside denominators. A valid submitted case with missing grade or technical failure stays in the denominator with no match; score remains null, never converted to zero.

service_modes.sokrat: Native teacher demo: own task, mathematics, EGE, extended solution, KIM15, max2; original task PNG and original solution PNG; optional text answer/rubric blank.
service_modes.tyutor: Native teacher checker, grade11/profile mathematics; exact transcription of original task and visible answer; original solution PNG; no additional prompt or rubric. UI model google/gemini-2.5-flash.
service_modes.sdamex: AI chat, default quality Medium (Средне), new chat for each pair of original task/solution PNGs, exact minimal user prompt. Formal checking tool unavailable per returned responses; chat grades evaluated.
